display_title: 超级幻想王国 Super Fantasy Kingdom

reviews.text: Finally… my kingdom (and my free time) are gone 👑💀 I’ve been waiting for this game to drop like a man lost in the desert waiting for rain. The free demo had me hooked instantly, I told myself I’d “just try it for 10 minutes” and next thing I knew, the sun was rising and my coffee was cold. Now that it’s out, I’m fully ready to hardcore grind my soul away in Super Fantasy Kingdom. I don’t even care if my villagers start a union or if the monsters eat half my population, I’m here for the chaos, the loot, and the dopamine. Huge shoutout to the solo dev, you made something dangerously addictive. Send help. Or don’t. I’m not leaving my throne anyway. 👑🔥
好玩无需多言，DEMO时期就已经玩了快30小时，就是好玩！
我石乐志才会买这游戏 弓箭手尼玛个鸡的居然还有射击盲区老子真是曹乐 僧侣这哈B居然不知道给自己加血我也是服了

局外养成养成占比极大，打不过挫败感很强，还只能通过一直失败来强化自己（每局成长爽感比不上挫败感来的强），完全就是用这方式来拖时长，完全不如王之凝视和九王的爽感。 感觉对我来说挫败感很强的重要原因是这游戏在前期没有“获胜”这一概念，总会在某一天被怪物大军淹没，可能每一把可以往前推一天，但是我玩到现在五个小时还是只有失败失败失败，真的玩的巨委屈。😭😭😭 玩了快十个小时了，玩着只有恶心，不会再玩下去了，要买的建议先看看别人的差评能不能接受这游戏的缺点。
你妈了个逼的，局外养成长的跟屎一样，你妈逼六个小时了还尼玛在原地踏步
难度太高了，希望降低难度
难度太高，导致不停的重头再玩，重复度变高，容易厌倦。算是中评，非常挑玩家的游戏。

不是哥们，作为一个有局外成长的类似war3塔防的固定流程轻度随机游戏。 你让人连着运营五六把一天都推进不下去，每次都死在20日甚至运气不好19、18日晚上很搞笑吗。 死了也不会根据完成进度加经验，纯跟着解锁多少个道具走，然后你道具池子默认的又那么浅，玩多少把都是那几个东西就算升满级了也没法无法打过下一波。 谁教你这么做守波游戏的？ 要是DEMO版本的灾厄高难度模式也就罢了，你这可是基础游戏难度，懂不懂什么叫基础？ 连着死五六次老是死在同一波数然后回主菜单一看解锁的道具数还不到20%，解锁英雄还他妈要宝石，我如果把宝石花在英雄上那就是毫无提升了懂不懂，珍贵的宝石是要花在珍贵的地图成长上永固下来的，你还TM要我花25个宝石解锁英雄？ 你知不知道为了攒3个宝石我需要收集你设置的逆天的64个糖果/血液甚至要存活15天，一把打下来也就可怜的十七八个宝石，连个英雄都解锁不了。 这一把把打下来真的毫无提升啊，局外成长跟艾尔登法环：黑夜君临学的是吧？ 反正在修改这个垃圾解锁机制之前，我是一定要给差评的。 怎么会有玩了十多个小时图鉴解锁不到20%就解锁不下去卡关的肉鸽游戏
游戏整体不错，游戏中有一个道具，每天晚上每两个浆果从生成一个新的浆果从，这个道具会一直生，最后生成了一百多个浆果丛，导致我没有其他地方种树，挖矿等等，最后游戏输了，建议给这个道具设置一个上限，比如最多只能到20个或者30个，不然没人敢选这个道具了
连续玩了两天，游戏是好玩的，但是感觉现在挫败感太强，难度有些高，局外养成太多了，对于一些不那么硬核的玩家容易劝退。我有一个建议是不是考虑每7天能存个档，毕竟如果前期的发育我认为没问题的话我可能每次都会和之前发育一样，能存档避免了反复从头开始的挫败感，提高解题的快感。

非常不推荐！ 局外非常非常非常肝！ 1.每一个新角色都要设置一些阴间任务来解锁，为了解锁一个角色你需要专门往那个方向发展，而且不一定一局就能成功！加上谜语人般的描述有些你都看不懂怎么解锁，很可能你玩了几十小时招募角色时发现来回就那几个。 2.蓝色宝石获取和需求严重不成正比，就算是通关了一局游戏(1h)也就二三十个蓝色宝石，开路和解锁需要几百个宝石，而且人类和不死族解锁不互通！你换个王国又要从0重新肝，如果这一局没发育好失败了你可能一局游戏打完0提升，保守估计光把地图开了就要200h以上，谁这么闲把把重开？ 3.每一个王国要重新肝，每一个英雄道具格子要重新肝，圣物抽奖还能出重复的你也要重新肝，难度解锁要累计奖杯也要重新肝，为了玩下一个难度强迫你每个角色都要把前面难度再打一遍，而你新英雄没有格子大概率前几局打不过又要重新养成一边。而且一局游戏保守一个小时以上。 最后作者SM了
累，工人和食物是前期重点，一个地方分配一个工人，勉强活着，英雄们吃完食物升级也没见再涨数据，那我为啥要喂他们？到了14天以后粮食依旧短缺。还有那个拿了我20个宝石的女巫，拿完就跑了到底给啥奖励了？？？
一坨，一次二三十分钟的突然死亡可能什么局外提升都带不来，公式化的刷资源，微乎其微的肉鸽元素，蜗牛般的局外成长

这些国产厂商 是不是 被网游和各种国产手游PUA的脑子不正常了？ 这个思维固化了嘛？ 把玩游戏变成折磨 这个资源获和成长模式 简直是开玩笑啊 你一个小体量的独立游戏打算让人玩多久啊 ？ 一遍又一遍重复的开头 爽又爽不起来！！！ 两三遍新鲜感过后完全就成了折磨 你们看看吸血鬼幸存者是怎么做的？ 同样小体量 重复一遍又一遍 但是玩着爽啊 本身是小体谅独立游戏 重这个画风来的 爽玩几个小时也不是不行 没人想着能像 卖2 3百块的大型游戏 那样玩几十上百个小时 你想让玩家玩的时间长 你可以更新新内容啊 加DLC也行啊 制作者是不是受网游或者氪金手游的影响 思维固化了？ 内容不多 但是把肝度拉满 来获得游戏时常 这样折磨人 简直是恶心人

通关一次就不想玩了，太蠢了，为什么一个主打策略，建设，肉鸽游戏能做到既不策略也不建设也不肉鸽的？因为资源被卡的死死的。建筑是造不满的，英雄是拮据着买的，所有的运营都被限制在有限的资源中。 很难想象快通关了都在打巨龙了的王国只有7个农民，比前线的英雄还少，而且朝九晚五，天稍微暗一点马上滚回家睡大觉的农民，还会有恶劣天气不能采矿不能打猎，你认真的吗？ 每种材料一天收集就个位数，然后还有开采过度的风险，然后劳动力也严重不足，然后物价也都是翻倍的，所有的策略都是围着资源转，排兵布阵？英雄克制？天气系统？如果你想让我体验到这些你先他妈把房子限制解开懂吗？ 通关一次连科技和建筑都升不满就戛然而止了。肉鸽元素更是一点没有，你是怎么好意思套用肉鸽游戏的局外成长和难度升级模式的？肉鸽因为节奏快随机因素多才让人能接受重复的尝试，我就不谈每次失败的挫败感有多严重了。你随机在哪？决策在哪？因为资源受限每次都必须公式开局，每天装模作样选个意义不明的敌人就是随机元素了？ 而且你的局外成长是人能想出来的？我以为哈迪斯那种猛猛肝科技点已经够逆天的了，没想到更逆天的是你，科技点都不能继承，美其名曰把道路点开通了就可以永久保留，但是一失败就归零意味着你必须不断的重复刷新最佳纪录才能获得微薄的成长。 综合评价一下，还是我开头说的，既不塔防也不建设更不肉鸽，纯纯的被资源卡住一切，所有策略都必须围着资源转的逆天游戏，但凡不想着怎么卡资源，而是把难点放到每波怪物的战斗处理上，让英雄养成和城防建设，基地科技变得选择性多起来，操作多起来，这个游戏就能好玩。

Let's be clear this game's progression moves at the speed of a tectonic plate. You don't "level up" so much as you "incrementally ooze" toward the next stat point. It's 3 AM. My eyes feel like two dry grapes. But my brain, that traitorous lump of dopamine-starved jelly, is chanting: "One More Run" because every tiny, incremental win feels amazing. But here’s the real kicker. I was 17 hours in. I had my builds figured out. I was a seasoned, hardened veteran of the grind. I leaned back, satisfied, thinking, "I've finally beaten it."And that's when I clicked a menu icon I'd somehow ignored. It wasn't a new skill tree. It wasn't a challenge mode. It was an entire, new separate campaign.

I went into Super Fantasy Kingdom expecting a cute, cozy, pixel art time wasting game that I’d fiddle with between existential crises and trips to the fridge. What I got instead was a near 150-hour spiritual journey that radically transformed me as a person.......twice. This game didn’t just surprise me but it tuned me into the best version of myself. For the first several dozen hours, this game genuinely improved my life. I was calmer, kinder, and finally managing my time like a functioning adult because every session of battling monsters, harvesting fantasy wheat, and feeding my armies somehow rewired my brain chemistry. I started waking up earlier, I drank water, even allowed me to take deep breaths instead of aggressively sighing at my email inbox. Super Fantasy Kingdom lulled me into a wholesome rhythm with its charming pixel art, its mechanics so simple and cozy, along with its soundtrack so gently cozy that even my dog started sleeping better. I was healed. Then after burning 80 plus hours I realized that I was so focused on my Human kingdom that I had already unlocked the Undead Kingdom many moons ago and immediately became everything my therapist feared. The moment i realized the option appeared on the screen “Play as Undead?” a cold wind blew across my living room. My house lights flickered. I heard a faint whisper that spoke to my very soul “Yesss… choose violence.” Naturally, I found myself in a new dark kingdom without hesitation. And just like that, my path of light evaporated faster than my self-control at a Texas-sized BBQ platter Suddenly I was no longer the benevolent hero who protected the realm and organized my kingdom by focusing on high end cooked steaks. No. I became the Lich CEO of Chaos, a walking W-2 exempt from morality. My entire kingdom was shaped like a cemetery. My minions moaned in existential agony and I loved them like my own children. My productivity plummeted, sleep schedule dissolved, and moral compass spun out of control. Super Fantasy Kingdom didn’t just let me relapse into darkness… It encouraged it. It celebrated it. It gave me buffs for it. Here’s the wild part, even as I descended into necromantic madness, the game stayed cozy. The pixel art? Adorable. The gameplay? Relaxing enough to trick you into thinking you’re not assembling an army of skull-flinging monstrosities. The challenge curve? Chef’s kiss and rewarding without being exhausting. It’s the rare game where I can be morally questionable AND comfortable at the same time. If you want a game that: looks cute but corrupts your soul feels cozy but consumes your free time is simple but secretly strategic makes you say “just one more run” until the sun rises and provides the perfect pixel-fix without melting your brain …then Super Fantasy Kingdom is the most life-changing (and life-ruining) moola you’ll ever spend until you start saving your coins and faith in SFK. I went from darkness → light → undead darkness with better perks and honestly? I regret nothing. 10/10 would betray humanity again. Cannot wait to see what the full game has to provide as this is already currently 2 games in one and can only imagine what the future has to bestow. The dev team is constantly dialed into the community and is focused on creating an experience for the gamer. You will not regret this.

非常精彩的像素博弈游戏,成长感和时刻平衡生产的感觉太好了以至于连续两天玩了几十个小时,非常棒的游戏,推荐！唯一有点遗憾的是,中文机翻出现了一些倒装句错误,如果能核对并更新一下将会更加完美。 英雄平衡性太差了,很多英雄拿出来一看就知道完全无法使用,就是纯粹的弱。比如大部分什么攻击两个,三个施加XX的角色,前期不强,中期不强,后期又是垃圾。攻击距离一点点,太拉了。 1251杯解锁全部内容通关,在花点时间可以打更高,不过没什么意思了,内容全部解锁已经。整体来讲游戏内容玩到这个时候实际上是固定的,其它无非一些随机性的阵容搭配。这个游戏的角色平衡性确实很差,很多角色就是一眼垃圾,而且没有任何惊喜可言。全程拉。结束。

太坐牢了，资源少，刁民到点就跑了，工作效率更是低下，英雄成长也几乎跟没有一样，既没有成长的成就性，又没有认真运营带来的正反馈，到死就那么点刁民干事就算了还到点就跑，你妈的你不知道你的王国危在旦夕？心这么大啊就敢到点跑回去睡觉？不能一间屋子挤一挤？帝国时代都知道一间屋子+5人口你一屋子1人口还需要解锁石路？！你什么贵族少爷我问你了？提点工作效率我就不说了，一天一个村民能产几块木头啊？英雄的成长也不提了升级甚至跟没有一样，还说什么肉鸽元素，真想硬套就一天给一张卡选择英雄成长而不是隔着快要死了才给一张垃圾卡！甚至信仰资源，那么吃紧你说我要先弄金币给护林人还是先给英雄成长一下？要我去赌20金币换20信仰吗？做不到啊。资源太吃紧了玩起来一点爽感都没有，烂！纯粹的，太烂了！

Alright, so I played this game a ton, it's great. But also, it's disappointing. You'll think there's another way to progress through the game, and you will be confronted by the fact that it's to bonfire max. You are currently a fool who doesn't even know what a bonfire is and you may think I'm resentful. One day you will realize the only way to progress is bonfire maxing, and you will know my disappointment.

7/10 游戏是好玩的，但是节奏设计是尴尬的 正因觉得好玩，所以数值节奏带来负面体验始终无法忽视 优点： 1.回合制、挂机战斗，轻松愉快 2.数值简易，获得提升时，成就感足 3.像素风，不花哨，辨识度高 缺点： 1.数值卡得过严。怪数值高、解锁慢、每次失败获得提升很少，过于拖时间了 2.局外成长需要在局内使用新东西，意味着你一局游戏中，要么放弃强度去捡垃圾，要么为了强度放弃局外解锁。就是左右都不爽， 3.越到后期，一局的时间越来越长，而能获得新东西越来越少，同时各种解锁要求越来越难 4.结合上面三点，我已经连续死在27波5次了。而这已经是我追求强度的情况了。然后……我打不过怪，也解锁不了新的东西，每把打一个多小时。只有挫败，而几乎没有解法…… 建议： 1.真的需要重新调整数值曲线，至少让玩家在每次失败有可观的收益。现在的曲线，有些强行延长游玩时长了，现在已经不是20年前了，我们都很忙。 2.说明书做全，更详细，我13个小时，我还有些游戏机制都搞不清楚。比如我到现在都不知道英雄的经验值获取是怎么计算的。 3.稍微优化一下汉化，有时候真读不懂。 4.增加一些便捷功能。例如，固定3倍数、每日收益数据统计。 5.解锁机制不应该限制于“使用新物品”，这样逼玩家用不爱用的东西感觉很恶心。可以相互结合，使用新物品增加解锁进度，但是每次失败也会根据 建设度/杀敌数 来额外获得解锁值，这样可以优化很大的体验

This is poorly described in the tags and promos so here goes: a Rogue-Village, auto-battling, clever resource manager. There's no bullet-hell action (wtf PC Gamer?) there's no deck of cards... at all. Even more of a tower-defense than dungeon crawler for pete's sake. What it is is quite an original and quirky, addictive brain-burner that rewards opportunism and replay. Actually... because of the human and undead versions... it's effectively TWO of those things. It's as if '9 Kings' had a baby with 'Loop Hero' and then it got elected baby mayor of Hell.

As of right now, this is a tentative recommendation based on a few factors. 1: Get it on sale. I don't feel that in its current state it warrants a $20 price tag. That is likely to change once more content gets added, but as it is, that's a tiny bit too high imo. 2: You have to be okay with cycle-based games. IE: Once you win or lose, you go back to the beginning. There is no infinite mode. You either win, or you lose. 3: You have to understand how to manage resources both for improving your kingdom AND unlocking new areas. If you spend too much solely on your kingdom, you're not going to make much progress when it comes to unlocking benefits for future runs, and if you spend too much on unlocks, you're not going to have enough resources to survive. 4: You have to be okay with losing your first few runs. There are a lot of mechanics that you need to learn that, while basic, aren't always immediately obvious at first glance. Once you learn the game a bit better, this will become a non-issue. 5: You have to understand that your role in the game is more akin to that of a strategist than an active part of the fighting. While you have access to combat spells, what matters most is smart unit placement and upgrades. If all of that is fine by you, you'll likely enjoy the game. If not, steer clear.

It's an addicting game but not necessarily a good one. Understand going in that it is the definition of a grind - you will need to replay many, many, many times and each run will likely only yield a scant amount of progress towards the ultimate "end game". This will continue until you hit a certain threshold with your build, and then it becomes less about beating each run, and more about minmaxxing your build so that you can earn as much points and therefore progress as possible each run. It can be satisfying, but also frustrating and repetitive. There often doesn't feel like much variety in terms of how each run plays out, and I find myself mostly sticking to tried and true strategies instead of experimenting or building new synergies. It's easy to get sucked in, especially early on, and the runs themselves are very long, sometimes upwards of an hour in length to complete the entire 29 days. Not sure if I would recommend this for everyone, but it can be a fun experience for some.

/ 10 }--- ☐ 1 ☐ 2 ☐ 3 ☐ 4 ☐ 5 ☐ 6 ☐ 7 ☑ 8 - I really like this game, it's not Cyberpunk 2077 but if you like roguelikes, city builder/management, and/or tower defense games you'll enjoy it. ☐ 9 ☐ 10 _____ If you: Hated Risk of Rain 2 because "It takes too much time to finish a run" Returned FTL because you died on your first 3 runs and couldn't figure it out Are not a fan of the Civilization series because it's too confusing and you hate the strategy of it Don't like games with "Pokemon graphics" Don't want your family to read science fiction because it's against your lord and savior jesus christ Hate Catan Returned Vampire Survivors because you got bored of "the grind" in your first 2 hours Hate Bloons Tower Defense Are Edgy and hate joy This is not your game, I'll save you the time and just let you know you'll hate this. ________ For those who enjoyed FTL and unlocked all of the ships, for those who like the strategy of a good RTS like Civilization and enjoy the challenge of planning and can handle the loss of an hour long game, for those who have played 2000+ hours of Warframe/WoW/Diablo and have any tolerance for what a grind actually feels like, here is your review: To start, I believe "early access" is a stretch here. I'm 12 hours in, I know for certain I have a long ways to go for unlocking the rest of the map, the majority of the units in the game, heroes, items, and I have barely began touching the surface on a majority of the challenges. All I have touched so far is the "Human" kingdom, there is a whole other kingdom with an entirely different map to try. I would not be surprised if there was 40+ hours of gameplay here if you try to 100%. While a lower price tag is good for indie games like this, I think it'd be a stretch arguing this is worth less than the current price. Just going by a standardized $1 USD / hour, if you play to complete the full game you'll exceed the target no problem and enjoy the time spent. A lot of the reviews posted talk about "grind". Anyone calling this a "grind" gets antsy at the barber shop because they're seated for too long, I'm not sure what they expected out of this but nothing about the grind is cruel. This is a roguelike; you are supposed to make some progress, try to win, fail at that, and go back to the beginning with a head start and some more tools under your belt. It's not "slow" grinding, this is a fairly standard roguelike and you'll see plenty of major jumps in your first 10 runs. Expect runs to start in the 30 minute range before you get overwhelmed, and get to the ~1 1/2 hour range if you're really taking your time and have a lot of unlocks/progress under your belt (serious runs with winning as an achievable goal). Expect to lose at all stages of the game even if you're well-off, expect the turn around to be quick when you restart because progress is usually very apparent here and makes early game a breeze. For the game itself, it is a somewhat unforgiving roguelike RTS in an inconspicuous package, and it feels great. The developer is incredibly driven and has an active online presence, and the game so far is already a masterclass in balance and design. As far as I could tell from regular play with no YouTube tutorials or speed run guides, nothing really feels inherently overpowered or cheap to use after 12 hours of playtime; there might be some combos that buff your characters very well, but I haven't had anything extreme come across my screen yet. If you enjoy management games, city builders, roguelikes like FTL and 9 Kings, and you are looking for a really unique challenge; this is your kind of game. Hope this helps.
